tests.meaning: Declarations are internally consistent; DEV service and OS permission isolation are explicitly NOT_PROBED/NOT_VERIFIED.
Retired per-task launcher remains BLOCKED/NOT_RUN and creates no container, database, volume or credential.

implemented: Fixed DEV/TEST identities with explicit service, compose, database, port, network, volume and credential separation and PAPER-only mode.
Offline isolation verifier rejects shared resources, non-PAPER modes, unpinned TEST deployment and invalid roles.
Docker operation allowlist permits only version/info/ps/inspect/logs; denies prune, rm, volume, system, build/pull/run/exec, VHDX, migrate and unknown operations.
Finite budgets for worktrees, concurrency, runtime, run count, temp databases, containers, disk, artifacts and leases; zero/infinite values rejected.

Persistent bounded test queue with deduplicated idempotency keys, single heavy concurrency, explicit heavy authorization, honest PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN, no automatic retry and no silent lease takeover.
Temporary database lease manager verifies fixed DEV instance, database name, OID, connection role and lease; precise reclamation refuses active connections, expiry, foreign/unknown resources.
Resource monitor reports unregistered/legacy resources and disk thresholds with no delete/cleanup entrypoint.
Offline status CLI exits 0 only for internally consistent declarations; it never claims OS isolation or a probed DEV service.
not_run: Actual DEV and TEST service provisioning/health inspection.
DEV/TEST data, credential, port, network and volume isolation on the host.
Docker daemon/socket/named-pipe permission denial and allowlist enforcement by the OS.
PostgreSQL temporary database creation, OID verification, role grants and precise drop.
Scheduler execution of real subprocesses, leases under crashes, disk telemetry and queue concurrency.
Container/disk/legacy-resource monitoring against the real host.
blockers: Shared DEV recovery, isolation and unified scheduler evidence remains absent; user-confirmed on 2026-10-31.
No Docker build, database qualification, migration application, TEST deployment or TEST data access was performed.
scope_note: This evidence proves offline policy logic only. It does not establish operational environment enforcement.
